svg.aria-label: Licence path in order. 1, CORE hunter safety course, about 21 hours, needed for most licences. 2, FWID in WILD, free, age 10 or older, one per hunter. 3, prove BC residency, renewed every three years. 4, resident hunting licence, 32 dollars or 7 dollars at 65 or older, electronic. 5, a species licence for each animal that needs one, deer 15 dollars, mailed if bought online, right away in person. 6, LEH draw, only for Limited Entry Hunting seasons. 7, for ducks or geese the federal bird permit, 17 dollars. Carry photo ID, your FWID number and every species licence, used or not.

g.data-tip: 1. CORE course|CORE (Conservation and Outdoor Recreation Education): about 21 hours of self study and firearm handling practice. Proof is needed to buy most licences.
2. FWID in WILD|Your FWID (Fish and Wildlife ID) comes from WILD (Wildlife Information and Licensing Data), Service BC or FrontCounter BC. Free, age 10 or older, one per hunter for life.
3. Prove BC residency|Prove residency in WILD (Wildlife Information and Licensing Data) every three years. Some military, students and youth are exempt.
4. Resident hunting licence|$32, or $7 at 65 or older. Electronic only, on your FWID (Fish and Wildlife ID) profile.
5. Species licence|One for each animal that needs one: deer is $15. Bought online it is mailed; in person you get it right away.
6. LEH draw|An LEH (Limited Entry Hunting) authorization is not a licence. You still need the hunting licence and the species licence.
7. Ducks or geese|The federal MGBHP (Migratory Game Bird Hunting Permit), $17, with its habitat conservation stamp.
Carry while hunting|Photo ID, your FWID (Fish and Wildlife ID) number and every species licence from this licence year, used or not.
g.text: every species licence, used or not
